title: p.apyr.us docs page: shared article page actions (icons, post links, share popup, article_actions)
description: Write the p.apyr.us documentation page for the shared article page actions. Source material: docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md section 'Icons, post links and the share popup' and 'Placing the actions on a custom article template', and docs/agent-readable-sites.md. Cover pageActions.display and actions (x, reddit, share), the no-JavaScript behaviour, what the post links carry (title and address only), and page.article_actions() for custom templates. Do not mention speed. Screenshots at phone and desktop width from the PPY-77df35 review.
